description: Returns a link where a patient can start an expert review of their case by OpenCancer and Cancer Commons scientists (records, options, trial shortlist, next step). The link only opens an intake page: no case is created and no records are sent. The patient enters their own details and personally confirms consent on that page. Accepts no names, contact details or records.

question.description: Optional: what the patient wants experts to look at, without personal identifiers.

name: open_case
title: Get the expert review link
